summary: CP2 death = a deliberate air U-turn (D held 1.5 s); the human flies ~1 s more east to a ramp. Built --noise-tau (AR(1)-correlated sampling noise, per-decision distribution unchanged), --noise-tau-frac (only a fraction of envs correlated) and --noise-tau-cond (exact conditional credit). Arm 1 (warm, all envs): 27.90 at 901M (CP2 death point crept west/up) but KL ran away; arm 3 (ratchet + 25% envs) keeps KL at the iid level; arm 4 (same + T heated to 2): training episodes now reach the human's detour region (x 4.5-6.5k, z ~11.0-11.6k) and survive there, no return past the death point yet, greedy 27.4. Continuing arm 4. Best ckpt is 24M steps after its eval.
